india.one_line: Indian enterprises scale up AI adoption while entry-level tech jobs face disruption from automation.

themes.title: Firms move from AI pilots to production
themes.text: Indian businesses have shifted from pilot tests to full-scale enterprise production over the past year and a half, reporting tangible benefits.

stories.headline: Oracle India says firms are moving from AI pilots to full-scale production

themes.title: AI automation threatens graduate tech jobs
themes.text: Nasscom President Rajesh Nambiar warned that AI automation of entry-level coding could impact jobs for recent Indian engineering graduates.

stories.headline: Nasscom President Rajesh Nambiar warns AI may impact tech jobs for graduates
